body: PR #2728 (claude/bug-2176) is ready for review, from implementer impl-2176. Merge-holds and clearances now resolve against the primary checkout via main_worktree_root_from, so a hold written from an aida-pr-N worktree stays visible and survives removing that worktree. A contained reviewer falls back to a local marker, which the standalone launcher adopts. merge-hold list warns about stray worktree markers. No release condition is loosened. The final assertion of the BUG-1188 test in pr_cmd.rs is changed, because it encoded the bug. The implementer reports test-touched 9085 passed, plus check-ci-compile and check-ci-fast green. Separately, existing label-only holds on #2710, #2713 and #2723 still need an operator clear.
subject: Review request: PR #2728 (BUG-2176) merge-hold store root
